mutants.name: json-slug-filter-removed

mutants.name: newest-receipt-selected-before-slug-filter
mutants.why: picking the newest receipt from all glob matches before the slug filter means a newer <stem>-2 receipt (no transcript) wins over an older stem receipt (attended); 6d places the older attended receipt first and the newer neighbour second — without the filter the newer one is picked, the transcript check fails, and the push goes out instead of being suppressed
mutants.anchor: newest, data = max(slug_matches, key=lambda x: x[0].stat().st_mtime)
